 // This is an independent fade, never a second pass through the Main-line gradient.

 if(bassRows.length){
  // One shared cursor reference. Space freezes only the Bass-Grid foundation;
  // on release the right marker immediately rejoins the cursor's current pitch.
  const heldRoot=__xenKeyboardFoundationDetach.rootHz();

   const isPlayedBass=!row.muted&&playedRow===row&&playedBass!==null&&playedBass.strength>0;
